title: Pennywise pipeline
description: One system pipeline: its steps in run order and the adapters each step may run. Budgets can override a step's adapter and AI model; they can't add or remove steps.

id.description: Must match the file name (message.json → "message"). Stored in budget overrides: never rename.

description.description: One sentence on what the pipeline does, shown in the UI.

version.description: Bump whenever the steps change. Jobs record the version they ran under.

steps.description: In the order they run. Step IDs must be unique.

id.description: Stored in budget overrides: never rename.

defaultAdapter.description: The adapter used when a budget hasn't chosen one. Must be one of this step's adapters and not unavailable.

fallback.description: Whether a model adapter tries the owner's other models of the same kind, by priority, when its model fails. Budgets can override it.

adapters.description: Ways this step can run. Adapter IDs must be unique within the step.

id.description: Stored in budget overrides: never rename.

usesModel.description: Calls a model from the budget owner's own AI setup, so a model can be chosen for it. Set modelKind too.

modelKind.description: The kind of model the adapter calls: "chat" for a conversational LLM, "decision" for a decisions-API model. Required when usesModel is true; the step's model picker only lists the user's models of this kind.

unavailable.description: Listed but not built yet; budgets can't choose it.

maxTokens.description: Caps the model's output. Only for adapters with usesModel.
